_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Pair on one repository
scenarios.description: Read, edit, run and commit in the repository I opened it in. Nothing outside it. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.

scenarios.label: Explain this codebase
scenarios.description: Read and answer. Do not change anything, do not run anything. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.

scenarios.label: Write and run tests
scenarios.description: Add tests and run them; I will commit. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.

scenarios.label: Set up my machine
scenarios.description: Install tools and configure my environment, anywhere on the disk. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.

scenarios.label: Publish the package
scenarios.description: Build, tag, sign and publish a release under my name. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.

scenarios.label: Keep a daemon running
scenarios.description: Start something that outlives the session and keep it healthy. No confirmation prompt stands between the mandate and the machine.
